lightDarkTreatment.light: Use the transparent PNG directly on light surface-topbar backgrounds; keep the navy/cyan strokes visible without inversion.
lightDarkTreatment.dark: Use the dedicated high-contrast transparent PNG with cool-white and cyan brush strokes on dark surface-topbar backgrounds; switch through the shared lockup component when the root dark theme class is active.

fallbackBehavior.componentFallback: If the image fails, the shared lockup keeps the accessible label and visible Chinese platform description.

promptSummary: Modern Chinese brush-calligraphy wordmark for 智控深蓝, deep navy ink with cyan highlights, generated by image2 on chroma-key background and converted to alpha PNG; dark asset preserves the generated alpha shape and remaps visible strokes for dark-mode contrast.
backgroundTreatment: Source image generated on #00ff00-style chroma key; final light and dark assets use transparent alpha.
reviewNotes: Use through src/components/shared/platform-brand-lockup.tsx rather than embedding asset paths in route pages.
Keep text alternative as 智控深蓝 for screen readers.
